facility.name: Crystals Childcare & Preschool, LLC.
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1901 N MAIN ST, MIDLAND, TX, 79705

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies: A child had a food allergy plan in the file indicating a severe reaction. However the child's name and allregy plan was not posted in the kitchen where food is prepared. This was corrected at inspection when the director posted the allergen and the child's name in the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Child's Food Allergies (26 TAC §746.401(10))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: This standard was found to be out of compliance when a child was able to reach adult scissors resulting severe injury to a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: This standard was found to be out of compliance when a caregiver did not see and was unable to intervene before a child was seriously injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months: A classroom did not have any outdoor play time in the morning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director has not renewed the infant trainings for SIDS, Shaken Bay Syndrome, and Early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: A two-year-old child does not have a current immunization record. The record has one immunization given at birth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver hired April 2024 does not have all required hours of training. @4 hours of preservice were completed but only 19 hours of annual training hours were completed. by April 2025. The caregiver lacks 5 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. It was determined that caregivers have been observed working on clerical duties while children are out of control in the classroom, not noticing children being picked up or supervising what children are doing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. The operation staff failed to communicate with a parent of an incident involving their child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. Observation of the classrooms determined that the children are often at free play with little caregiver interaction. Children are often out of control.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: One new employee hired 6/24/24 was left alone with children but has not completed at leat 8 hours of preservice traiing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One 3-year-old child is missing 34th Dtap, 2nd Hep A, and 3rd Hib vaccines. One 4-year-old child has an incomplete vaccine record (only last vaccines on file).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Name and Birthdate: One child's admission form does not have areas of authorization for emergency care or authorization for filed trips filled out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Name and Birthdate (26 TAC §746.605(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: One child has a listed food allergy on their admission form but there is not a food allergy plan in the the child's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Four employees hire June 2023 have not completed all 24 hours of annual training in addition to their 24 hours of preservice. Two  caregivers have completed 18 hours. One caregiver has completed 15 hours and the fourth caregiver has completed 20 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a listed food allergy on the admission form does not have a food allergy plan at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The class was getting ready for a filed trip. Two children were out in the hallway getting their shoes on without supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's products form has nnot been updated since 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to report to CCR of a situation placing a child at risk when a caregiver left a child alone in a classroom for 10 minutes in September 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left sleeping alone in the classroom for 10 minutes in September 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: A child who turned 4 years of age June 2023 did not have a vision/hearing screening result in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: Toddlers under three and two years of age were served whole slices of peaches that  were not cut into smaller pieces.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. The staff have given children food identified on their food allergy list despite parent requests, documentation at admission, and having the food allergy posting in the classrooms and where food is prepared.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-Proof of DFPS background checks: Four employees do not have proof pf background check letters in their files stating they are eligible to be present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-Proof of DFPS background checks (26 TAC §746.901(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Two new employees left alone with children have not completed at least eight hours of preserve training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A caregiver left the clorox cleaning wipes on a shelf under the diapering table, accessible to children. A child was at the shelf.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash her hands after changing a diaper and removing the gloves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child's hands were not washed after the diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. Staff did not actively supervise the children. Both caregivers in the room had their backs to the children involved in the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: This standard was evaluated and was found to be out of compliance. The fire extinguisher was not mounted securely in a bracket, out of reach of children, at the time of the incident, and was a cause of injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Toddler worm climbers on the playground were placed on concrete surface. Five toddlers were actively climbing the equipment. This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the equipment from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver left alone with children has completed on line CPR/First Aid certification. A second caregiver left alone with children has not completed CPR/First Aid certification in pediatric cardiopulmonary.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: The center did not have running water in the building. Staff and children were not using soap and water to wash hands. Staff relied on hand sanitizer after toileting, and diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground loose-fill was an inch deep and not as 6 inches deep as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation did not notify child care regulation of the lack of water in the building due water line/plumbing issues.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §746.305(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's products form was not updated sine 2019. This was corrected at inspection when the director renewed the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit in the transportation van was missing tweezers and scissors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Name and Birthdate: This standard was reevaluated and is still out of compliance. On child still does not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Name and Birthdate (26 TAC §746.605(1))
